# witr

> A single static-binary CLI (Linux, macOS, Windows, FreeBSD) that answers "why is this running?" by tracing any process, port, container, or open file back to the exact causal chain that started it — supervisors, containers, services, shells — as human-readable output, JSON, or an interactive TUI.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pranshuparmar/witr/main/README.md): the full manual: purpose (section 1), installation (2), using witr with AI coding agents (3), the interactive TUI (4), example outputs (5), flags and options (6), exit codes, output sections and the `--json` contract (7), and platform support (8).
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pranshuparmar/witr/main/plugins/witr/skills/witr/SKILL.md): how an AI agent should use witr: which command fits, reading the JSON and exit codes, and asking before stopping anything.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pranshuparmar/witr/main/docs/cli/witr.md): every flag, the exit codes and example commands, generated from `witr --help`.

## Optional

- [Interactive tutorial](https://pranshuparmar.github.io/witr/): browser-based guided tour and free-play sandbox, no install required.
